settings.name: Earliest nest use date (mm-dd)
settings.description: Earliest date to analyse (start of intensive nest use; mm-dd)

settings.name: Latest nest use date (mm-dd)
settings.description: Latest date to analyse (end of intensive nest use; mm-dd)

settings.name: Nest cycle duration (days)
settings.description: Duration in days of intensive nest use

settings.name: Buffer (meters)
settings.description: Buffer in meters around which fixes can be considered to be at the nest

settings.name: Minimum fixes within buffer
settings.description: Minimum fixes within buffer to allow for a centroid to be considered a nest

settings.name: Minimum fixes per day (Bird-day)
settings.description: Minimum number of fixes per day for bird-day to be included in analysis

settings.name: Minimum consecutive days
settings.description: Minimum consecutive days of use for a point to be considered a nest

settings.name: Minimum peak-attendance fix percentage
settings.description: Minimum GPS-fix percentage at a location on its peak-attendance day

settings.name: Minimum percentage days of use
settings.description: Minimum % days of use for a point to be considered a nest

settings.name: Earliest month to keep data
settings.description: Earliest month to keep data (active breeding start)

settings.name: Latest month to keep data
settings.description: Latest month to keep data (active breeding end)

settings.name: Maximum fix frequency (minutes)
settings.description: Max frequency (minutes) of fixes to use

settings.name: Minimum fixes per day (Filter)
settings.description: Minimum number of fixes per day for that bird-day to be included in analysis

settings.name: Nest radius (meters)
settings.description: Radius in meters around nest for a fix to be classified as "at the nest"

settings.name: Minimum acceleration bouts per day
settings.description: Minimum number of acc bouts per day for that bird-day to be included in analysis

settings.name: Laying threshold probability
settings.description: When smooth probability goes above this (1st time) = laying date

settings.name: Hatching threshold probability
settings.description: When smooth probability goes below this (last time) = hatching date

settings.name: Minimum incubation days (Single clutch)
settings.description: Minimum number of days of incubation period in single clutches

settings.name: Minimum incubation days (Second clutch)
settings.description: Minimum number of days of incubation period in second clutches

settings.name: Filter output to predicted ID-years
settings.description: If true, filter and return only individual-years with breeding predictions
